lblClnLyricsAuto: Kai-sarrafa kansa (waƙoƙin da aka tsara a matsayin SYLT, a bayyane a matsayin USLT)
msgClnLyricsHint: Waƙoƙin da aka tsara lokaci sune layukan da ke farawa da lokaci kamar [01:23.45]. SYLT shine daidaitaccen tsari don waƙoƙin da aka tsara lokaci, USLT don rubutu mai sauƙi. Atomatik yana karanta rubutun kuma yana rubuta ɗaya daga cikinsu. Tare da "Koyaushe USLT" ana ajiye rubutun da aka tsara lokaci kamar yadda yake, sai dai idan ka cire lokutan. Waɗannan zaɓuɓɓukan suna aiki ga alamun ID3 (MP3, AIFF, WAV); sauran tsare-tsare suna ajiye rubutun waƙoƙin a filin su.
msgDstRelativeHint: Babban fayil mai alaƙa kamar convert, .\convert ko ..\convert ana ƙidaya shi daga babban fayil ɗin kowane fayil. Ba a kiyaye tsarin babban fayil ɗin ba.
